name: STAGE
source:
Drama club works hard to complete a play for the "STAGE" school festival. Through everyday activities main character grows bonds with the participant girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
戏剧社为在校庆“STAGE”上完成一部舞台剧而努力排练。日常相处中，主角与参加演出的少女们逐渐建立起深厚羁绊。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
